title: Standing microwaves in an oven
caption: Neighbouring nodes are half a wavelength apart, so nodes 6 cm apart mean λ = 12 cm and f = c/λ = 2.5 GHz. Food at a node barely heats, which is why ovens use a turntable.
alt: A standing wave with nodes every 6 centimetres across a 24 centimetre span, antinodes halfway between.
description: Nodes every 6 cm: λ/2 = 0.06 m, so λ = 0.12 m.
Antinodes, where the field and the heating are strongest, lie halfway between nodes.
